documents.text: HTTPS calls fail with bare file not found when SSL_CERT_FILE points to a deleted temporary certificate. Remove stale TLS environment overrides and use the default trust store.
FastMCP decorators introspect function signatures. Preserve tool schemas by normalizing errors and results at the tool manager dispatch boundary instead of using args kwargs wrappers.
ArangoDB cluster traversals need WITH vertex collections and path-wide version filters. Test against multiple co-resident dataset versions.
Run deterministic offline quality evaluation in CI and compare structured metrics to a versioned baseline. Exit nonzero on regression without requiring paid model APIs.
Use a multi-stage non-root container image, scan the built runtime image, and document expiring vulnerability exceptions.
Validate OIDC issuer audience expiry and rotating JWKS. Intersect token scopes with profile and database policy.
Classify AQL using the server parser AST. Reject insert update replace remove upsert and ambiguous dynamic function calls in readonly mode.
Run global PageRank and weakly connected components in the Graph Analytics Engine rather than AQL.
Resolve readonly developer operator and admin tool profiles, then subtract exact tool and category denylists before registration.
Require short-lived HMAC human confirmation bound to actor action parameters and expiry. Consume each token once and reject replay.
Separate process liveness from dependency-aware readiness and keep a deprecated health alias with no-store responses.
Enforce hard runtime row response byte bulk input and concurrency ceilings at centralized dispatch with machine-readable denial and truncation metadata.
